'''Dionysius''', also known as the '''Wise Old Man''', is a legendary and very powerful [[Saradominist]] wizard and former adventurer, currently residing in [[Draynor Village]]. He is infamous for the [[Draynor bank robbery]]. He wears light brown robes, a regular [[blue cape]], [[partyhat & specs]], and wields a short [[staff]].

When asked, he tells the player about his feats throughout [[Gielinor]], and recognises players' own accomplishments &ndash; he sells the [[quest point cape]] and the [[quest point hood]] for 99,000 [[coins]] once all [[quest]]s have been completed, a total of {{Globals|quest points}} [[Quest points]].

He also offers a service to remove quest items or "junk" from the bank. Players can enter their bank pin to access the "[[Wise Old Man's Recycling Centre]]" showing unusable or otherwise worthless items, mostly from completed quests, which can all be removed from the bank at once.

Lastly, if the player asks "Is there anything I can do for you?" he can assign [[Wise Old Man tasks|various tasks]] on [[members]]' worlds, in exchange for small rewards and experience. 

Being an iconic character, he has featured in various [[holiday events]], some as minor cameos, and others with more significant roles, like the [[2017 Christmas event]] in which he took over for [[Santa]] that year.
